title: Rooftops and Urban Buildings with Palm Trees, 1945 B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
JUL 30 1945
BROWN PHOTO SERVICE
Minneapolis, Minn.
585 A
description: An elevated cityscape view captured across rooftops, showing multi-story mid-century commercial and residential buildings with visible palm trees and utility infrastructure. Stamped on the reverse by Brown Photo Service of Minneapolis, Minnesota, dated July 30, 1945, near the final weeks of World War II. The print features decorative deckled edges typical of mid-1940s snapshot processing.
